funnel.universeDefinition: 317 observed S&P 500 listing rows used for discovery, including some dual-class listings. No claim of full market-wide fundamental screening: connected Massive financial endpoints were not entitled. Twenty focused reviews combined prior source-checked history with freshly retrieved filings, quote/technical data and news. Failed or unverified stages are null, not fabricated counts.

policy.ownerInstruction: Remove the structural downtrend filter and quality trap filter.
policy.technicalRole: Inform technical state, score and timing only; no automatic price-trend exclusion. Business checks remain.

limitations: Massive financial and option snapshot endpoints not entitled; legacy financial endpoint unavailable.
AlphaStocks quotes lack exchange timestamps; no intraday VWAP/reversal verification.
Option references can be days old; no live contract selection is approved.
No market-wide fundamental pass counts, three-year returns or current breadth invented.

rejections.reason: Major fundamental/regulatory uncertainty: FHFA opened mortgage credit-scoring competition to VantageScore. Q3 earnings/FCF growth are strong, but price recovery cannot be treated as temporary valuation compression with an intact moat. Newly announced restructuring adds uncertainty.

Positive GAAP profit and FCF, but latest GAAP net income fell 12%, operating income 5%, and margin 171bp. FY26 GAAP EPS guidance indicates a mid-single-digit decline. Not the improving-earnings setup; exclusion is based on business momentum, not either removed trend filter.

Q2 GAAP net income fell about 23%, operating profit about 58%, and gross/operating margins materially contracted. Latest FCF declined about 10% and acquisitions increased debt. Keep under review until the economic effects are clearer.

Q2 EPS includes a $1.52 tax benefit; FCF fell from $588M to $460M and operating cash flow from $616M to $520M. Strong subscriptions/operating profit warrant monitoring, but complete cash-quality/history verification is required before qualification.

Latest GAAP EPS includes a large disposal/investment gain. Organic revenue growth was 5%; company headline FCF is adjusted. Not enough freshly verified four-quarter, unadjusted cash/earnings evidence to qualify in this scan; no claim that the business is permanently broken.

Revenue and operating income improved, but only 2 of the latest 4 GAAP net-income comparisons increased, with large tax/investment effects. Revenue growth decelerated; autonomous-vehicle competition requires further thesis review.

Latest revenue, GAAP profit and FCF improved. Observed price is 9.1% below the verified $75 recent high; no compelling support/valuation dislocation established for the smaller-pullback lane. Pandemic ATH is an unsuitable automatic recovery target.
GAAP profit and FCF improved, but the quote is near its 52-week high after a large rally. No attractive discounted entry established; exclude on opportunity/valuation grounds, not technical strength.
GAAP net-income surge includes strategic investment gains while operating income and quarterly FCF declined. Does not show the requested simultaneous improvement in underlying earnings and cash.
